_notes: Hand-drawn zones on top of the automatic areas. Each zone is a polygon of [x, z] points in world metres. mode override replaces the spot's area presences with the zone's areas; mode add raises each of the zone's areas to at least its value, leaving other areas as they are. Presences run from 0 to 1. The first matching override wins and ends the list; add zones before it are dropped. The old share field is accepted and ignored. Empty until the zones are drawn in the game.
